library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(stringr)

setwd("E:/bioproject/PRJEB86033")
initial_meta <- read.csv("SraRunTable.csv", header = TRUE) 
head(initial_meta)

metadata <- data.frame(
  BioProject = initial_meta$BioProject,
  Run = initial_meta$Run,
  sample_name = initial_meta$Sample.Name,
  BMI = NA,
  Sex = initial_meta$sex,
  Region = initial_meta$target_subfragment..exp.,
  Platform = initial_meta$Instrument,
  Site = initial_meta$env_material,
  public_time = initial_meta$ReleaseDate,
  Status = initial_meta$status_host,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Region = str_replace(Region, "region$", ""),
         Sex = recode(Sex, "female" = "F", "male" = "M"))
metadata$Age <- "4"
metadata$Country <- "China"
metadata$PCR_primers <- "341F-805R"
metadata$title <- "Single-tooth resolved, whole-mouth prediction of early childhood caries via spatiotemporal variations of plaque microbiota"
metadata$Disease_study <- "YES"

print(paste("Number of unique runs:", length(unique(metadata$Run))))
print(paste("Number of unique sample names:", length(unique(metadata$sample_name))))

plot_data <- metadata %>%
  select(-BioProject, -Run, -sample_name, -title)

create_simple_plots <- function(data) {
  plots <- list()
  
  for (col in colnames(data)) {
    if (all(is.na(data[[col]]))) {
      p <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "this column is NA", size = 6) +
        labs(title = col) +
        theme_void()
    } else if (is.numeric(data[[col]])) {
      p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
        geom_histogram(fill = "blue", alpha = 0.6, bins = 20, na.rm = TRUE) +
        labs(title = col) +
        theme_minimal()
    } else {
      count_data <- as.data.frame(table(data[[col]], useNA = "ifany"))
      p <- ggplot(count_data, aes(x = reorder(Var1, -Freq), y = Freq)) +
        geom_col(fill = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(title = col, x = NULL, y = "Count") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    }
    plots[[col]] <- p
  }
  
  return(plots)
}

plots <- create_simple_plots(plot_data)
grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 3, top = "Metadata Summary")

metadata <- metadata[, c(
  "BioProject", "Run", "sample_name", "Age", "BMI", "Sex", 
  "Region", "Platform", "Country", "Site", "public_time", 
  "PCR_primers", "title", "Disease_study", "Status"
)]

write.csv(metadata, file = "metadata.csv", quote = FALSE)
